name: Fix Command Whitelist and Registry Issues

userStories.title: Fix local command semantics
userStories.description: As a user, I want local list/mkdir commands to work on local filesystem only, not call remote gRPC.
acceptanceCriteria: local list uses local filesystem, not gRPC client
local mkdir uses local filesystem, not gRPC client
Commands marked as "local" are correctly categorized in registry

userStories.title: Fix completion command blocked by whitelist
userStories.description: As a user, I want completion command to work without whitelist configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: completion bash outputs shell completion script
completion zsh outputs shell completion script
No whitelist config file required for completion

userStories.title: Fix whitelist initialization side effects
userStories.description: As a user, I want local token set to not create whitelist config files.
acceptanceCriteria: local token set does not create whitelist config
Only whitelist-related commands initialize whitelist config
Non-whitelist commands skip whitelist initialization entirely

userStories.title: Support alias in whitelist enable/disable
userStories.description: As a user, I want to enable/disable commands using their alias names.
acceptanceCriteria: whitelist enable storage.add.s3 enables cloudapi.login-s3 (alias group)
whitelist status shows both requested ID and canonical ID

userStories.title: Prevent duplicate command IDs in registry
userStories.description: As a developer, I want registry to panic on duplicate command IDs to catch bugs early.
acceptanceCriteria: registry_init.go uses MustRegister for all commands

userStories.title: Fix upload failure resource leak
userStories.description: As a user, I want failed uploads to properly close remote file handles.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload errors close file handle before returning
No orphaned file handles after upload failure
